source.publication: 2025 Nebraska Individual Income Tax and Amended Return Booklet (8-307-2025), with 2025 Form 1040N and Schedule I
source.section: Form 1040N PDF pages 1-2, lines 2a, 4a, 4b, 4, 5, 6, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 17, 18, 34, 35; booklet PDF page 12 lines 2a, 4a, 4b; PDF page 13 line 5, line 6 and the Nebraska Standard Deduction Chart; PDF page 14 lines 10 to 18; PDF page 17 lines 34, 35 and the Federal Tax Liability Worksheet; PDF pages 46-49 Tax Table and over-77,760 worksheet (schedule as numbers, as settled in the record from the table); Schedule I line 32; booklet PDF page 26 Line 32 ('All military retirees are allowed to exclude 100% of the military retirement benefits'); record ne_military_retirement_exclusion

worked: Single, 58: military pension 30,000 and nothing else. The subtraction takes all the income, so the standard deduction takes line 14 below zero. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = military pension (you) 30,000.00 = 30,000.00. Federal taxable income = 30,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 14,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form 1040N filing status (1) single, resident. Line 2a: 0 box(es) checked (no one born before January 2, 1961). Line 4a 1; line 4c none; line 4 total 1. Line 5 federal AGI 30,000.00. Line 6 Nebraska standard deduction, chart for 0 box(es): 8,600.00; lines 7 to 9 skipped (no federal itemizing); line 10 8,600.00. Line 11 = 30,000.00 - 8,600.00 = 21,400.00. Line 12 adjustments increasing federal AGI 0.00. Schedule I Part B: line 32 military retirement 30,000.00; line 44 total 30,000.00. Line 13 = 30,000.00. Line 14 = 21,400.00 + 0.00 - 30,000.00 = -8,600.00, less than zero, so the form enters 0.00. State income after additions and subtractions (before the deduction) = 30,000.00 + 0.00 - 30,000.00 = 0.00. Line 15 tax 0.00. Line 16 0.00 (no lump-sum or early-distribution tax); line 17 = 0.00. Line 18 personal exemption credit = 171 x 1 = 171.00; line 34 171.00. Line 35 = 0.00 (nonrefundable: nothing of the credit is used). Federal Tax Liability Worksheet (PDF page 17): line 2 is zero or less, so line 35 is 0.00.
